_comment_method: Bypass mode: 'direct' (no spoofing), 'fragment' (ClientHello fragmentation), 'fake_sni' (decoy SNI), 'combined' (fragment + fake SNI), or 'mitm' (TLS-terminating relay — the tool builds its own self-signed SSL, decrypts the client's session, then re-encrypts to the real upstream with a fresh ClientHello, i.e. the tls-decrypt / tls-repack-frommitm idea).
_comment_cipher_suites: Custom upstream TLS cipher suites in xray cipherSuites format (colon-separated IANA names). Used for the upstream ClientHello in MITM mode and for the raw-injector fake hello in standard mode. Null = built-in defaults.
_comment_finalmask: finalmask TCP fragmentation (faithful xray port). A JSON array of fragment rules, or a path to a JSON file containing such an array. Mirrors the FINALMASK_TCP in the reference tls-repack-frommitm outbound.
_comment_mitm_cert: MITM mode TLS certificate. Leave MITM_CERT_FILE/MITM_KEY_FILE as null to auto-generate + cache under ~/.snispf/ (stable SHA-256 fingerprint across restarts for pinning).
_comment_mitm_alpn: ALPN protocols offered on the upstream (fresh) TLS connection. IMPORTANT: whatever the client negotiated (e.g. http/1.1 for VLESS+WS) is forwarded upstream INSTEAD of this list — offering h2 would make Cloudflare pick h2 and break the HTTP/1.1 WebSocket upgrade. This list is only used when the client sends no ALPN.
_comment_mitm_use_client_sni: The upstream TLS SNI cannot differ between your ISP and Cloudflare - both see the same bytes. When true (default, recommended): the upstream ClientHello carries the client's real SNI so Cloudflare routes correctly, and FINALMASK_TCP fragments that hello on the wire so DPI cannot reassemble/read the SNI. When false: the upstream uses each pool pair's FAKE_SNI (full IP x SNI pool + SNI discovery stay active) but routing then relies on the Host header alone - only works for setups whose CDN ignores SNI mismatch; most Cloudflare worker/VLESS setups FAIL with fake SNI.
_comment_mitm_raw_injection: Also run raw fake-SNI injection (seq_id trick) on the MITM upstream dial. Requires Administrator (Windows + WinDivert) or root/CAP_NET_RAW (Linux). Injects an out-of-window ClientHello carrying MITM_RAW_FAKE_SNI (decoy) so DPI sees a benign SNI, while the real routing SNI is still sent in the uTLS ClientHello. Combines with FINALMASK_TCP for defense-in-depth. When false/unsupported, MITM hides the SNI with FINALMASK_TCP fragmentation only. IMPORTANT: this is the raw packet injector, independent of the direct/combined forward-mode raw path.
_comment_mitm_raw_fake_sni: Decoy SNI used in the raw-injected hello in MITM mode. Defaults to FAKE_SNI when unset.
_comment_fingerprint: Browser TLS fingerprint for the upstream ClientHello in MITM mode, mirroring xray-core: presets 'chrome', 'firefox', 'safari', 'ios', 'android', 'edge', '360', 'qq', 'random' (pick a preset per connection), 'randomized' / 'randomizednoalpn' (unique randomized hello), 'unsafe' (plain Go TLS, no impersonation), plus pinned versions like 'hellochrome_120', 'hellofirefox_105', 'helloedge_106'; or null to disable (default). The upstream TLS handshake is delegated to the snispf-tls sidecar (tools/snispf-tls, based on uTLS — the same library xray uses) which sends a byte-perfect ClientHello. SNI and ALPN always stay client-mirrored. Requires the sidecar binary.
_comment_fingerprint_tls_bin: Explicit path to the snispf-tls sidecar executable. If unset, the tool looks in <repo>/bin/ (after running tools/snispf-tls/build.bat or build.sh) and then on PATH.
_comment_pool: Multi-IP + Multi-SNI pool settings (ported from SNI-Spoofing-HJ).
_comment_pool2: If both CONNECT_IPS and FAKE_SNIS contain more than one entry, all combinations are probed and the best ones are used automatically.
_comment_pool3: Set CONNECT_IPS / FAKE_SNIS to single-element lists to disable the pool and use the original single-target mode.
_comment_recycle: Recycling — periodically re-tests evicted IPs in quarantine and restores the healthy ones with a fresh history.
_comment_quarantine_scope: Which IPs are eligible for eviction/recycling: 'static' (only CONNECT_IPS from this file), 'dynamic' (only IPs found by discovery), or 'both'.
_comment_sni_evict_recycle: SNI eviction/recycling — mirrors the IP eviction/recycling settings above, but for the SNI axis. Weak SNIs are quarantined and periodically re-tested.
_comment_sni_quarantine_scope: Which SNIs are eligible for eviction/recycling: 'static' (only FAKE_SNIS from this file), 'dynamic' (only SNIs found by SNI discovery), or 'both'.
_comment_discovery: Dynamic IP discovery — scans Cloudflare CIDR ranges at runtime and injects fresh IPs into the pool.
_comment_sni_discovery: Dynamic SNI discovery — pulls candidate domains from Tranco/Majestic/Umbrella + a curated seed list, checks Cloudflare hosting, and probes with a real TLS handshake before injecting them into the pool.
